hardware: Apple M5 Pro (15-core), 24 GB unified memory, PyTorch MPS backend, macOS 27.0; no discrete accelerator. Peak memory measured with /usr/bin/time -l (maximum resident set size) on a 3-query, 1-drawing run including model loading; the 57-query wall time is infer.py's own elapsed counter and excludes about 10 s of process start and model loading. The full run was mostly in macOS low power mode (about 25 s per query before the slowdown; see solution/report/REPORT.md).
